nyt_headline: A Steadier Anaesthetic? Remimazolam and Blood Pressure

pico.pop: Adults receiving general anaesthesia or deep procedural sedation
pico.out: Incidence of peri-induction or intraoperative hypotension (per-trial threshold: SBP below 90, or MAP or MBP below 65, or a 30% drop)
pico.subgroup: Threshold and timing differ by trial (overall intraop vs post-induction vs ERCP); pooled as the literature does

trials.name: Jeon 2023 (TIVA, older adults)

trials.group: Remimazolam vs propofol induction in angiotensin-axis-blockade users; post-induction hypotension (MBP<65 or >=30% drop)

trials.name: Xiao 2024 (ERCP)
trials.group: Remimazolam vs propofol GA for therapeutic ERCP; intraoperative hypotension (MAP<65 >=1 min)
